actions.new_feature: run_format:statement_report - run of statements.statement_run with report_format = statement_report (side_effects none): one row per eligible responsible-party account, count and totals; never writes. View Only runs it and sees the list on screen; the PDF print and the XLSX / CSV of the list need Full Control of the statements family (PD-10), exports additionally reports_export_data_files.

run_format:statements - run with report_format = statements (side_effects writes): one statement document per eligible account, PDF layout statement in volumes of 500; the commit_builder writes a NEW statement_runs header (DATA-22) and one frozen patient_statements row per account (batch_id = statement_runs id, statement_date, totals, ageing, message, snapshot of the lines, delivery_status generated) in the terminal transaction. Needs action_right_codes.commit = reports_statements_screen_full_control and a confirmation (confirm_side_effects); never cached, never scheduled.

action:update_statement_dates - bulk action (scope bulk, legacy_action UPDATE STATEMENT DATES) over the snapshot of a succeeded statements run: per account sets accounts.last_statement_date and accounts.statement_locked_through to the run's statement_date, sets the run's patient_statements rows (by batch_id) to delivery_status sent and delivery_method print (email or both once e-statements apply; NEW delivery_status vocabulary generated / sent / paper_sent / emailed / reopened, owner 03 DATA-22), so they print as the 'Statement Sent - $X.XX' ledger line; stamps the NEW columns statement_runs.dates_updated_at / dates_updated_by (DATA-22); skips accounts whose balance changed since the run (reason balance_changed); idempotent per (batch_id, action_key, account_id). Right reports_statement_allow_updating_statement_dates; confirmation required; a statement_date equal to the office-local today needs a second confirmation (vendor advice).

Statements meaning: strictly greater than, applied to the total balance of the guarantor account (insurance plus patient portions, all offices of the account, as of statement_date; rpt_ar_open_items unit account). Accounts with a balance of exactly 0.00 never qualify. Legacy measure (account total versus estimated patient portion) is not documented in so many words - confirm on the live tool with an account whose patient portion is below and whose total is above the threshold.

Statements meaning differs from the Aging reports: the threshold account_balance_over already drops every account below 5.00, so true ADDS the accounts whose total balance is negative (credit statements) to the population; the threshold is not applied to them. false = no credit statement. Meaning inferred (no vendor description); confirm on the live tool.

Role layout on format statements: true removes the ageing grid (Current ... Over120, Total Balance, Estimated Insurance / Patient rows) from each statement; Total Due stays. Whether Reg Cont. Bal. / Ort Cont. Bal. are removed as well is not documented (proposal: kept). On format statement_report it has no effect. Meaning inferred from the label (no vendor description).

Role layout on format statements: true replaces the Estimated Insurance and Estimated Patient rows of the ageing grid by one row Total (Current ... Over120, Total Balance) and removes the Ins Exp / Pat Por columns of the service_style layout. Population unchanged. Meaning inferred from the label.

Role layout on format statements: true prints the remittance slip without the card fields (Credit Card # / CID / Exp Date / Name as it appears on the Credit Card / Type of Card / Signature); Check stays. Vendor viewer shows statement variants named ..._withoutCC, which fits; meaning otherwise inferred.

controls.legacy_label: Exclude accounts where statement was sent within last
controls.notes: Checkbox of the sentence 'Exclude accounts where statement was sent within last [n] days.'. true drops an account that has a patient_statements row that counts as sent (delivery_status in sent, paper_sent, emailed; reopened and generated do not count; set defined by DATA-22), any office, with statement_date > statement_date - n days and <= statement_date; with n = 0 only a statement of the same statement_date counts (inferred: the legacy reference day is not documented - statement date assumed, not today).

Day list of the within-last sentence, captured collapsed with value 0 and enabled while the checkbox is unticked (no enabling rule, 04 section 9.6; the value is ignored while exclude_statement_sent_within is false). Until the list is read, the server accepts an integer 0-365. Live check: expand the dropdown and record every value.

controls.legacy_label: Exclude accounts where patient portion is paid and insurance portion is expected
controls.notes: Default checked on Statements (captured and vendor text). true drops accounts whose open patient portion is <= 0 while an insurance portion is still expected (sum open_patient <= 0 AND sum open_insurance_est > 0 over the account's open items as of statement_date). For migrated charges without the claim_id backfill open_insurance_est is 0 (split_quality unknown), so such accounts are NOT dropped - counted in the run warning.
true drops accounts with rpt_account_dim.send_collections = true (the legacy Sent to Collection flag of the responsible party).

controls.legacy_label: Exclude Responsible Parties where the Patient has an open claim
controls.notes: Visible only with the organisation feature hold_statements_with_open_claims (rule d01). true drops an account when any member patient has a claim in rpt_claim_facts with status_class in (unsent, sent, partially_paid), NOT is_preauth and outstanding_quality <> unknown. Migrated open claims with outstanding_quality unknown do not hold the account: availability code open_claim_quality_unknown prints their count. Inferred: whether the legacy 'open claim' includes created-not-sent claims and pre-authorisations, and whether 'the Patient' means any member or the guarantor patient only - confirm on the live tool.

legacy_corrections.text: The caption belongs to six statement message boxes - General Message, Current Message, Over 30 Message, Over 60 Message, Over 90 Message, Over 120 Message - that the vendor's screenshots show on this screen; they were not rendered in our capture (recorded as added controls).

FINANCE CHARGES opens the separate finance-charge run (Finance Charge Date, Responsible Party Range, Exclude Responsible Party Type, Provider, Apply Finance Charge to: Patient Portion / Entire Balance, Apply). It is not a statement criterion; the dialog is recorded in the pickers file.

Statement Date is the billing date printed on the statement and the date of the ageing / "Total Due as of" line (read from the vendor's sample statements, which print `Billing Date :` and `Total Due as of <date> :`).
PAPER STATEMENT SENT is enabled in the vendor's screenshots; it is disabled only in our capture, so the greyed state is state-dependent. What enables it and what it does is not documented.
Last Statement Date and Last Close Out Date are read-only lock dates (display only, not criteria inputs).
Start Name / End Name are an alphabetical range by the responsible party LAST name.
Batch Statements follow the HOME office of the responsible party - the same office rule as Aging Report by Home Office. (The screen itself has no office selector.)
The red note follows from the statement run being per office: one consolidated statement per account from the responsible party's home office, with that office's settings and messages.
Account Balance Over is the minimum account balance for a statement to be produced.
No statement is produced for an account that was already sent one within the chosen number of days.
No statement is produced when the balance is expected in full from insurance. The option is on by default (vendor text), as captured.
No statement is produced for accounts flagged as sent to collection.
Excludes the accounts of the selected responsible-party types.

Statements itemise only the transactions entered since the account's Last Statement Date - this screen has no date-range criterion; when UPDATE STATEMENT DATES is skipped, later statements repeat the older history.
Last Close Out Date is the date of the last Close Out (Setup > Close Out), which locks all accounts through that date and cannot be reversed.
Action PRINT STATEMENT REPORT: prints the list of the accounts that are eligible under the current criteria, to be reviewed before the statements are printed.
Action PRINT STATEMENTS: produces the statements themselves as one PDF batch.
Action UPDATE STATEMENT DATES: writes a `Statement Sent - $X.XX` line to the ledger of every recipient, sets Last Statement Date and locks the data on or before that date.

Vendor sequence for the buttons of this screen: FINANCE CHARGES (if configured), then PRINT STATEMENT REPORT, then PRINT STATEMENTS (save the PDF), and UPDATE STATEMENT DATES only after the statements are confirmed correct.
Hidden population rule with no criteria control: a responsible party is skipped when `Send Statements` is unticked on the responsible-party record.
Further hidden population rules with no criteria control: a responsible party is also skipped when its balance changed after the pull, or when the account has allocation issues.

This screen has no PRINT FORMAT choice; a statement opens in the report viewer, whose header strip offers Export to Excel and Word. The vendor image cited is a statement shown in the viewer (article on reviewing a sent statement); the batch run itself is not shown.

Hidden rule with no control on this screen: the account option `Statement Update – Close out ALL statements including zero and credit balance statements` (Setup > Account Info > Advanced) makes UPDATE STATEMENT DATES also stamp the zero and credit balance accounts.
Vendor advice: do not run UPDATE STATEMENT DATES with today's date - it locks today's entries.

shared_rules.note: Hidden scope: the statement run is per office.
Present only when the account feature "Enable Advance Hold Statements with Open Claims" is on.
